# has SLSA level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSLSALevel`](gmeow-hasSLSALevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSLSALevel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The SLSA supply-chain integrity level (1–4) asserted by an attestation. Non-functional: competing assessments from different verifiers coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
